colophon: Thus ends the Ashtamurti Raksha Stotra composed by Sri Ishvarananda Giri.

lines.1: O Sharva, earth in form, lord of the mountain's daughter,
lines.2: O Dharma, rider of the bull, lord of Kanchipuram,
lines.3: forest-dweller, fragrant one, adorned with the king of serpents:
lines.4: O lord of the earth, protect me, Eight-Formed One, in your first form.
lines.5: O remover of fault, stain, and dullness, protector of the mountain's daughter,
lines.6: O lord of Jambukeshvara, Bhava, water in form,
lines.7: wet with the Ganga, wet with compassion, forever bathed:
lines.8: O linga of water, protect me, Eight-Formed One, in your second form.
lines.9: O Rudra, in the form of the fire at the end of time, destroyer of sin,
lines.10: O you whose limbs are smeared with ash, bringer of Kama's end,
lines.11: O form upon Aruna's mountain, dweller on Mount Arbuda:
lines.12: O lord of fire, protect me, Eight-Formed One, in your third form.
lines.13: O Matarishvan, wanderer of the great sky,
lines.14: O lord of Kalahasti, giver of strength,
lines.15: Ugra, lord of the pramathas, served by the princes of yoga:
lines.16: O lord of the wind, protect me, Eight-Formed One, in your fourth form.
lines.17: O you whose body is like the partless sky,
lines.18: O lord of the Hall of Consciousness, lord who sustains the universe,
lines.19: Shambhu, all-pervading, you who have entered the awesome small space within the heart:
lines.20: O lord of space, protect me with your compassion, Eight-Formed One.
lines.21: O Bharga, the sun, thread on which all the worlds are strung,
lines.22: O twelvefold self, whose body is the mantras of the Veda,
lines.23: Ishana, made of light, whose eye is the sun:
lines.24: O sun in form, protect me with your splendor, Eight-Formed One.
lines.25: O Soma, with the half-moon, self of the sixteen digits,
lines.26: O you who dwell among the stars, crowned with a sliver of the moon,
lines.27: master, great god, who roams within the mind:
lines.28: O moon in form, protect me with your nectar, Eight-Formed One.
lines.29: O lord of the cosmic sacrifice, you who wear the form of the sacrificer,
lines.30: O light of the self that lives in every being,
lines.31: renowned as the one lord of all bound souls, worthy of praise:
lines.32: O lord of the self, protect me, supreme Eight-Formed One.
lines.33: From the supreme Self, space was born first;
lines.34: from space, wind was produced; from that, fire;
lines.35: from fire came water, and from the waters, earth:
lines.36: to these, together with sun and moon, I bow forever;
lines.37: to the divine eight forms I bow forever;
lines.38: to them, made of pure awareness, I bow forever.
